site_name: Former Westferry Printworks, 235 Westferry Road, London, E14
description: Variation of Condition 2 of planning permission PA/23/02375 to increase the number of private homes and reduce the number of affordable homes, reconfigure internal layouts and external elevations.The description of development of permission PA/23/02375 is as follows: 'Comprehensive and phased mixed-use redevelopment comprising 1,358 residential units (Class C3), secondary school (Class F), commercial, business and services E(a)-E(g)(i), community uses (Class F), police base (sui generis) car and cycle basement parking, associated landscaping, new public realm and all other necessary enabling works.This application is accompanied by an Environmental Statement.'
